title: AI Agent Frameworks Reach Production Maturity
summary: Major tech companies have released production-ready AI agent frameworks, enabling autonomous task completion. This creates demand for engineers who can build, deploy, and monitor agent systems.

title: Maharashtra Announces EV Manufacturing Hub in Chakan
summary: State government announces a dedicated EV manufacturing zone near Pune with incentives for battery and motor component manufacturers. Expected to create 15,000+ jobs over 3 years.

title: Cloud-Native Architecture Becomes Default for Enterprise
summary: Enterprise adoption of Kubernetes and serverless architectures has crossed 70%. Cloud and DevOps skills are now baseline requirements for most IT roles.

title: CERT-In Mandates Cybersecurity Compliance for SMEs
summary: New regulations require SMEs handling sensitive data to implement cybersecurity measures and employ certified security professionals. Creates urgency for cybersecurity training.

title: Industry 4.0 Adoption Accelerates in Maharashtra Manufacturing
summary: Major Pune and Nashik manufacturing firms investing in smart factory upgrades — IoT sensors, robotics, predictive maintenance. Demand for mechatronics and automation skills surging.

title: RAG Becomes Standard Architecture for Enterprise AI
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation is now the default pattern for enterprise AI applications, replacing fine-tuning for most use cases. RAG engineering becomes a distinct skill.

title: India Drone Policy 2026 Opens Commercial Operations
summary: Updated drone regulations enable commercial operations in agriculture, surveying, and delivery. Creates demand for licensed drone pilots and technicians.

title: National Solar Mission Phase III Targets 500GW
source: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
summary: Ambitious solar targets require massive workforce expansion in installation, maintenance, and system design across Maharashtra's solar-rich districts.

title: Pharma Sector Shifts to Continuous Manufacturing
summary: Leading pharma companies adopting continuous manufacturing processes, requiring updated skills in automation, quality control, and process monitoring.

title: Blockchain-Based Supply Chain Tracking Gains Traction
summary: Major logistics and manufacturing companies implementing blockchain for supply chain transparency and compliance tracking.

title: Prompt Engineering Emerges as Entry-Level AI Skill
summary: Companies across sectors are training non-technical staff in prompt engineering. While not a standalone hiring skill for tech roles, it's becoming a baseline productivity skill.

title: Maharashtra Smart Agriculture Mission Launched
summary: State launches digital agriculture initiative covering precision farming, drone spraying, and IoT-based crop monitoring across Vidarbha and Marathwada regions.
